study type: Prospective Cohort Study (Model Development and Validation)
exposure: history of miscarriages in the first week of pregnancy
cohort: The study included 685 pregnant women with a single pregnancy during the second trimester (16-26 weeks) for model development, and an additional 119 pregnant women for external validation.
finding: A predictive model and scoring system for spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) was successfully developed and validated, showing high accuracy and potential for early detection and risk assessment.
